text.tspan: ECS load balancer integration and data volumes (EFS, S3 Files)
• ALB: supported, works for most use
• NLB: only for high throughput / high
no Fargate). Docs now list only
• Mount EFS onto ECS tasks; EC2 AND Fargate launch types
• Tasks in ANY AZ share the same data · Fargate + EFS = serverless
• Use case: persistent multi-AZ shared storage for containers
S3 Files file system ↔ S3 bucket
• S3 bucket exposed as a file system; changes sync to the bucket
• Course: Fargate + Managed Instances, EC2 NOT supported.
Docs (GA): Fargate, Managed Instances AND EC2. Needs a task role.
• "Shared persistent storage across AZs for Fargate tasks" → EFS. "Containers need file access to data already in S3" → S3 Files.
• Fargate also has 20 GiB+ ephemeral storage and can attach EBS volumes (one task, one AZ) — not shared.
